content.rendered:
1966: The Castiles play a sweet sixteen party for a high school classmate at the American Hotel in Freehold.

1973: Bruce and his unnamed band headline at the Rova Farm Function Center in Jackson, New Jersey, where a fight breaks out during (of all things) “Santa Claus is Comin’ to Town.” Luckily, the police break up the brawl and allow the show to go on.

2010: Just in time for Christmas, Bruce releases the video from his intimate concert at the Asbury Park Casino’s Carousel House a few weeks earlier.

2017: With Christmas Eve approaching, Springsteen on Broadway holds a rare matinee performance at the Walter Kerr Theater in New York City.

excerpt.rendered: Peace on earth hasn’t quite set in–a fight breaks out during an early performance of “Santa Claus is Comin’ to Town.”

jetpack-related-posts.title: December 22
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Watch Bruce's surprise appearance at a 2008 holiday show. Plus: Bruce heads west and gets his California driver's license. These and more highlights inside.

jetpack-related-posts.title: December 4
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: The Ties That Bind: The River Collection was released on this day in 2015. Other highlights from this date: guest appearances from Joe Grushecky, Tom Morello, and Mike Ness, rare River Tour footage, and more.

jetpack-related-posts.title: December 21
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: On this date: Born in the U.S.A. passes Thriller's run on the U.S. album chart, Bruce plays his first-ever show in Toronto, and more.

jetpack-related-posts.title: December 19
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: A holiday SNL appearance, Bruce's first-ever Canadian show, and two raucous holiday shows lead off today's highlights.

jetpack-related-posts.title: November 27
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Steel Mill opens for Black Sabbath, Bruce makes a Tonight Show appearance, and it's the world premiere of "It's the Little Things That Count." More highlights inside.

jetpack-related-posts.title: November 28
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Santa comes out in '99, an intense Magic show in Milan, and a unique Ramrod/Living on the Edge of the World mash-up--all and more from this date.
